title: Variance
text: 输入或输入序列的方差，输入 2 路、输出 1 路、无直接馈通；按 {Reset port} 指定重置事件；{Running variance} 用于选择运行方差、{Find the variance value over} 指定计算方差所沿的维度 Each、{Dimension} 指定自定义维度、{Input processing} 指定在运行模式下处理输入的方法 Columns、{Rounding mode} 指定舍入运算的方法、{Saturate on integer overflow} 指定溢出操作的方法、{Input-squared product output} 指定输入平方项的数据类型 Same、{Input-sum-squared product} 指定输入和平方项的数据类型 Same as input-squared、{Accumulator} 指定累加器数据类型 Same as input-squared、{Output} 输出数据类型 Same as input-squared、{Lock data type settings against changes by the fixed-point tools} 防止定点工具覆盖数据类型，按实例取值。

ports.name: In
ports.summary: 数据输入 vector | matrix | N -D array

ports.name: Port_1
ports.summary: 沿指定维度的方差 scalar | vector | matrix | N -D array

params.name: Running variance
params.values: 用于选择运行方差的选项 off (default) | on

params.name: Find the variance value over
params.values: 计算方差所沿的维度 Each column (default) | Entire input | Each row | Specified dimension

params.name: Input processing
params.values: 在运行模式下处理输入的方法 Columns as channels (frame based) (default) | Elements as channels (sample based)

params.name: Reset port
params.values: 重置事件 None (default) | Rising edge | Falling edge | Either edge | Non-zero sample

params.name: Rounding mode
params.values: 舍入运算的方法 Floor (default) | Ceiling | Convergent | Nearest | Round | Simplest | Zero

params.name: Saturate on integer overflow
params.values: 溢出操作的方法 off (default) | on

params.name: Input-squared product output
params.values: 输入平方项的数据类型 Same as input (default) | Binary point scaling

params.name: Input-sum-squared product
params.values: 输入和平方项的数据类型 Same as input-squared product (default) | Binary point scaling

params.name: Accumulator
params.values: 累加器数据类型 Same as input-squared product (default) | Same as input | Binary point scaling

params.name: Output
params.values: 输出数据类型 Same as input-squared product (default) | Same as accumulator | Same as input | Binary point scaling

params.name: Lock data type settings against changes by the fixed-point tools
params.values: 防止定点工具覆盖数据类型 off (default) | on
